decision_or_notes: - engine side built and tested 2026-11-13 (crates/live-engine/src/voicemeeter.rs + CLI `voicemeeter`): Remote API loaded from the registry install folder by full path; read-only `info()` (kind, version, rate, per-driver buffers, A1 device, strips with their insert channels); the insert host (`start`: register the input insert, wait for `STARTING`, publish the engine to the callback, restart on Voicemeeter's `CHANGE`, panic barrier with a dry pass-through, teardown that frees the engine only once the callback is provably silent); `Command.Save` snapshot, `Option.buffer.<driver>` + `Command.Restart`, load. Gate: fmt + clippy -D warnings + 186 workspace tests green. Unproven until measured with the owner: the delay the insert point adds (VB-Audio does not state it) and whether Voicemeeter runs below 256 frames on the class driver, so the engine is not yet offered as the default host

title: Latency slice (decided 2026-11-12, all six): probe diagnostics (output peak, Windows endpoint volume/mute, chosen format, xruns in the `latency` answer), adaptive duplex cushion in the exclusive host, system checkup (exclusive allowed, enhancements, rate mismatch, Bluetooth/HDMI as monitor output, power plan), latency budget UI (declared vs measured per stage, RO/EN), monitor option "tuned only for the audience" (ears: dry voice + reverb, stream: tuned voice), fast pitch mode (detector beside the audio path + period-synchronous shifter, target 0-4 ms instead of the fixed 5.3 ms; overlaps the pitch rewrite of WP21-21)
decision_or_notes: - five of the six built 2026-11-13, all gated (fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests green): (1) probe diagnostics - `latency` prints output peak, xruns, driver xruns, Windows endpoint volume/mute and names the failing part of the loop; (2) adaptive duplex cushion in the exclusive host (io.rs, 72 tests, 14 mutants); (3) system checkup - CLI `checkup` reports exclusive permission, enhancements, sample rate, endpoint volume, output kind (Bluetooth/HDMI), power plan and Voicemeeter ownership as 7 stable ids; (4) monitor option "tuned only for the audience" - a second chain = the main chain minus the pitch effects, fed by `set_mix {monitor_untuned:true}` (OSC `.../mix/monitor_untuned`), 10 ms crossfade, own scene tail, `meters.monitor_chain_latency_samples` (49-edit sync table at exactly 0.0, 23 mutants); (5) fast pitch mode - `autotune` gained a `fast` switch (off by default) that runs the period-synchronous shifter instead of the grain shifter (1 sample of delay at rest instead of a fixed 256 = 5.3 ms); measured on a 110 Hz tone asked to move +25 cents it lands 0.01 cents off where the classic shifter leaves the note untouched (-25.16 cents), which is the defect its ignored test `shifter_applies_small_corrections_at_110_hz` pinned; both paths are crossfaded over 10 ms so the switch does not click, and the fast shifter is not ticked while the mode is off. Open: the latency budget UI has only its first line (the desktop mix strip shows the ears' and the main chain latency and carries the `monitor_untuned` switch); the ASIO build waits for the SDK (not on this PC, not redistributable); the fast mode is not the default because on LOW notes its delay during a correction exceeds the classic shifter's fixed 5.3 ms (82 Hz: up to 12.2 ms, 6.1 ms mean) and its level falls below 1 dB under ratio 0.75 - the owner should hear both on his rig before it becomes the default
